_comment: Time-limited npm audit exceptions (ADR-017). Each entry names one advisory and one package. Max 31 days from approval. Enforced by scripts/check_npm_audit.py.

exceptions.reason: Denial of service (quadratic replacement) when decoding crafted input. Reached via expo-router 57 -> query-string 7.1.3 (needs ^0.2.2); the only patched release, 0.5.1, is ESM-only and query-string 7 requires it with CommonJS, so an override would break URL parsing. npm's fix is expo-router 58 (Expo SDK 58, a major upgrade) - planned as its own task. Checked 2026-11-02.
